name: No-Bake Cheesecake
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and melted butter. Press firmly into the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan.
Beat cream cheese until smooth. Add powdered sugar, vanilla, and lemon juice. Beat until fluffy.
In a separate bowl, whip heavy cream to stiff peaks.
Gently fold whipped cream into cream cheese mixture.
Pour filling over crust and smooth the top.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Top with pie filling before serving.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free cream cheese and coconut whipped cream.
substitutions.gluten_free: Use gluten-free graham crackers for the crust.
substitutions.low_carb: Use almond flour crust (1.5 cups almond flour + 4 tbsp melted butter), sugar-free powdered sweetener, and fresh berries instead of pie filling.

notes: Overnight refrigeration gives the best set. Do not freeze — texture becomes grainy.
